name: Nova Digitus Conversational AI
tag: A voice and chat assistant for customer conversations, with guardrails, intent detection and analytics.

scenarios.title: Handle an upset customer
scenarios.ask: Customer: 'My order hasn't arrived and I want a refund.' We get about {daily} conversations like this a day.

inputs.label: Refund limit before a person steps in

steps: Detected: late delivery, refund request. Tone: frustrated.
Order #20417 is with the carrier, due tomorrow.
Refunds over ${=limit} need a person. This one is $89, inside policy.
Apologized, shared tracking, and offered a refund or 15% off if it arrives.
followups: What if the refund were over the limit?
The assistant tells the customer a person will confirm, then hands the case to staff with the order and conversation attached.
Does it work on the phone too?
Yes. The same rules run for voice and chat, and voice calls get a transcript.
It's a sample figure. Your rate depends on how many questions are routine, which the analytics show after the first weeks.

scenarios.title: Find out why people contact you
scenarios.ask: Show me what our {daily} daily conversations are really about.
steps: Top three: delivery status ({=round(daily * 0.34)} a day), returns, and password resets.
Tone dips sharply on return questions.
Suggested a self-serve returns page and a clearer delivery email.
followups: Personal details are masked before analysis, and reports show topics and counts, not identities.
How do we act on it?
Each insight comes with a suggested fix and the number of conversations it could remove.

scenarios.title: Set the guardrails
scenarios.ask: Before going live, set what the assistant can and can't do. We have {topics} topics it should cover.
steps: Turned your policies into {=topics * 3} rules, such as refund limits and what not to promise.
Medical, legal and account-closure requests always go to people.
Set a {tone} tone with your brand words.
Ran {=topics * 10} test conversations, including tricky ones, before launch.
followups: What if a customer tries to trick it?
The test set includes attempts to get discounts or private data. The assistant refuses and logs them.
Can we change rules after launch?
Yes. Edit a rule and it applies to the next conversation, with a record of who changed it.
